title: The Gregory function and its completed Gregory transform
summary: We study the entire interpolation \[ \mathcal{G}(z)=\int_0^1 \binom{x}{z}\,dx \] of the Gregory coefficients. Its completion satisfies the positive Markov-transform identity \[ \frac{πz}{\sin(πz)}\mathcal{G}(z) =\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{n\left|G_n\right|}{n-z}. \] Consequently, every zero is real and simple; the negative zeros are the integers $-1,-2,\ldots$, and one zero $ρ_n$ lies in each $(n,n+1)$.
